Our Heritage
About Chilarai College
A beacon of higher education in Golakganj since 1973
1973
Established
Committed to Excellence
Nestled amidst lush greenery in the heart of Golakganj,
                        Chilarai College stands as a proud institution
                        dedicated to shaping minds and building futures in one of the remotest regions of Western Assam.
Founded in 1973 through the vision and tireless efforts of noble personalities who dreamed of bringing
                        quality higher education to rural communities, the college has grown into a vibrant academic hub where
                        tradition meets opportunity. Our campus fosters intellectual curiosity, ethical leadership, and a deep
                        sense of social responsibility among every learner who walks through our gates.
From undergraduate programmes to co-curricular enrichment, we remain steadfast in our mission to empower
                        students with knowledge, skills, and values that prepare them for meaningful careers and responsible
                        citizenship in an ever-changing world.
Quality higher education for rural & semi-urban communities
Serene, green campus fostering focused learning
Dedicated faculty guiding holistic student development
